queries.name: pre_clean_export
text: let
Source = Parquet.Document(File.Contents("C:\Users\Tom\Exercism\python\powerbi_training_log\data\pre_clean_export.parquet"), [Compression=null, LegacyColumnNameEncoding=false, MaxDepth=null]),
#"Invalid values to null: placeholders" = Table.ReplaceValue(Source, "Not Recorded", "", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"property_type", "built_form"}),
#"Invalid values to null: heated rooms" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Invalid values to null: placeholders", 0, null, Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"number_heated_rooms"}),
#"Invalid values to null: floor_height 1" = Table.AddColumn(#"Invalid values to null: heated rooms", "floor_height_nulled", each if [floor_height] < 1.5 then "" else [floor_height]),
#"Invalid values to null: floor_height 2" = Table.RemoveColumns(#"Invalid values to null: floor_height 1", {"floor_height"}),
#"Invalid values to null: floor_height 3" = Table.RenameColumns(#"Invalid values to null: floor_height 2", {{"floor_height_nulled", "floor_height"}}),
#"Invalid values to null: floor_height 4" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Invalid values to null: floor_height 3", {{"floor_height", type number}}),
#"Apply exclusions: exclude properties with total_floor_area <= 9 sqm" = Table.SelectRows(#"Invalid values to null: floor_height 4", each [total_floor_area] > 9),

#"Apply exclusions: huge properties with few or null rooms" = Table.SelectRows(#"Apply exclusions: exclude properties with total_floor_area <= 9 sqm", each [total_floor_area] <= 2000 or ([number_habitable_rooms] > 7 and [number_habitable_rooms] <> null)),

#"Apply exclusions: efficiency and consumption" = Table.SelectRows(#"Apply exclusions: huge properties with few or null rooms", each [current_energy_efficiency] <= 110 or [energy_consumption_current] <= 200 or not List.Contains(Parameter, [property_type])),
#"Apply exclusions: construction_age_band" = Table.AddColumn(#"Apply exclusions: efficiency and consumption", "Length", each Text.Length([construction_age_band]), type nullable number),
#"Apply exclusions: construction_age_band 2" = Table.AddColumn(#"Apply exclusions: construction_age_band", "construction_age_band_new", each if [Length] >= 4 then [construction_age_band] else ""),
#"Apply exclusions: construction_age_band 3" = Table.RemoveColumns(#"Apply exclusions: construction_age_band 2", {"Length", "construction_age_band"}),
#"Apply exclusions: construction_age_band 4" = Table.RenameColumns(#"Apply exclusions: construction_age_band 3", {{"construction_age_band_new", "construction_age_band"}}),
#"Inserted conditional column" = Table.AddColumn(#"Apply exclusions: construction_age_band 4", "floor_height_imputed", each [floor_height] = null)
in
#"Inserted conditional column"

queries.name: Parameter
text: let
Source = {"Flat", "Maisonette"} meta [IsParameterQuery = true, IsParameterQueryRequired = false, Type = type list]
in
Source
